## #1 — Swizl — 2013-06-11
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/9655/post-79677>

Script Request: Bolt Factory

Was wondering if one of the scripting gurus may be interested in doing A Cheetah style version for something like the one that Blender has? (not an exact match of course, but similar)

BoltFactory Link

It's done in Python, but at least the source code is readable. Not sure what could be gleaned from it and re-written in JavaScript? 

Anyway, I did a very crude menu item for it as that's all the JavaScript I can figure out. If nobody's up to it, that's cool. Just thought I'd take a shot at asking. Feel free to modify the Header Note too. (I put it in the Polygonobj Folder, but may be a better fit in one of the others).

Thanks!,

Simon

Attachments: [Bolt Test.js.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/20159/)

Links: http://wiki.blender.org/index.php/Extensions:2.6/Py/Scripts/Add_Mesh/BoltFactory
